heading: Advanced Nuclear Energy Licensing Cost-Share Grant Program

children.heading: Commission
children.text: The term “Commission” means the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.

children.heading: Program
children.text: The term “program” means the Advanced Nuclear Energy Cost-Share Grant Program established under subsection (b).

children.heading: Secretary
children.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Energy.

tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: The Secretary shall establish a grant program, to be known as the “Advanced Nuclear Energy Cost-Share Grant Program”, under which the Secretary shall make cost-share grants to applicants for the purpose of funding a portion of the Commission fees of the applicant for pre-application review activities and application review activities.

tree.heading: Requirement
tree.text: The Secretary shall seek out technology diversity in making grants under the program.

tree.heading: Cost-share amount
tree.text: The Secretary shall determine the cost-share amount for each grant under the program in accordance with section 16352 of this title.

tree.heading: Use of funds
tree.text: A recipient of a grant under the program may use the grant funds to cover Commission fees, including those fees associated with—

children.text: obtaining a statement of licensing feasibility;

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was enacted as part of the Nuclear Energy Innovation Capabilities Act of 2017, and not as part of the Energy Policy Act of 2005 which comprises this chapter.
